Hidden truncation observes a variable \(X\) only when a concomitant \(Y\)
falls in a specified set \(M\). The basic density is

\[
 f_{X\mid Y\in M}(x)=f_X(x)
 \frac{P(Y\in M\mid X=x)}{P(Y\in M)}.
\]

```{r}
library(HiddenTrunc)
x <- rhtp4(200,3,2,1,2,3)
fit <- fit_htp4(x)
summary(fit)
```

For the Arnold-Strauss bivariate exponential model, the package implements
two-sided hidden truncation \(d_1<Y\le d_2\) and both frequentist and Bayesian
computation.
